evals.prompt: Show me the working tree status of /repos/myapp.
evals.expected_output: Runs git_status against the repo path and reports staged/unstaged/untracked files.
expectations: Surfaces empty-message clarity when there are no changes

evals.expected_output: Runs git_diff_unstaged and shows the patch.
expectations: Surfaces empty result gracefully when diff has no output
Reads before write in the standard commit workflow

evals.prompt: Stage and commit these changes in /repos/myapp with message 'fix: login redirect'.
evals.expected_output: Follows the read-before-write workflow: status → diff → add → diff staged → commit.
expectations: Inspects state and diffs before staging
Runs git_add then git_diff_staged then git_commit
Uses the provided commit message verbatim

evals.expected_output: Runs git branch listing, optionally filtered.
expectations: Honors any filter the user supplied

evals.prompt: Show me the commit history for /repos/myapp, last 10 commits.
evals.expected_output: Runs git log limited to 10 commits.
expectations: Limits output to the requested count

evals.prompt: Create and switch to a new branch feature/payments in /repos/myapp.
evals.expected_output: Creates the branch and checks it out.
expectations: Creates the branch via git branch tool
Operates on the local repo only

evals.prompt: Reset the staging area in /repos/myapp — but ask me first.
evals.expected_output: Requires user confirmation before running the destructive git_reset.
expectations: Does not run reset without confirmation

evals.prompt: The repo at /repos/myapp has merge conflicts — can I commit?
evals.expected_output: Blocks the commit and surfaces the conflicted files.
expectations: Surfaces conflicted files to the user

evals.expected_output: Composite workflow: status, diff vs base branch, branch listing, history.
expectations: Surfaces state, diff, and branch info

evals.prompt: Someone passed a file path starting with -- to git add.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the path with a CLI flag injection error.
expectations: Rejects with CLI flag injection error
